title: Prove host launch choices and first input in Node Vitest

intentCoverage.report:
**Verdict. Caught.**

The check covers the blank Codex recovery promise in `SEED-413#prove-native-first-input-on-vitest` at `eac4d5e9e4041f64f603a5afc08378552a9c433c`. After the known history refusal, the original thread and saved workspace must both match before the launch can confirm blank persistence without sending a turn.

In the isolated checkout, I changed one line of `dashboard/server/hosts/codex/blank.ts:26`. The metadata read after the known refusal accepted any string for `cwd` in place of the literal saved workspace. The exact thread check and the ordinary history path stayed intact.

The maintained case “only matching native context with the known history refusal confirms blank persistence” failed at `dashboard/backend-tests/launches/agent-launch-ad-hoc-codex-recovery-boundary.spec.ts:144`. Its fake Codex supplied the original thread, returned the known refusal when turns were requested, and reported `${workspace}-wrong` on the metadata read. The assertion expected `kind: "uncertain"` and received `kind: "launched"`.

A separate scratch witness called the real `recoverCodex` through the socket fixture on that exact transition. It independently observed two reads of the original thread, first with turns and then without. The faulted path returned `launched` and recorded `{ state: "not-requested", intent: "blank" }` despite the workspace mismatch. The baseline and restored paths returned `uncertain` with no recording. All witness runs submitted zero turns.

The same maintained backend command selected exactly one Node Vitest case on each run. The clean baseline passed, the faulted run failed at the cited assertion, and the restored run passed. The scratch worktree started clean, was verified clean after restoration and after the final run, and was removed. The executions used Node 24.21.0, locked dependencies, one worker and `caffeinate -s -i` on AC power.

**Next proof action.** Keep the existing maintained assertion for this transition.

Run logs, strict proof records, witness outputs, and the preserved report are under `/private/tmp/dough-nfi.RXPGVW/`. The report file is `/private/tmp/dough-nfi.RXPGVW/report.md`.

- **Test runtime.** 5.416 s baseline, 3.759 s faulted and 2.865 s restored (measured by the backend proof reporter). The corresponding command wall times were 5.61 s, 4.22 s and 3.11 s (measured by `/usr/bin/time -p`).
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separate measure was collected.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. The host supplied no separate effort measure.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 156544 ms (measured), from 1795692170325 to 1795692326869 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition for checked revision eac4d5e9e4041f64f603a5afc08378552a9c433c. Caught. Keep the existing assertion. No follow-up.
